title: Skate
constraintsSummary:
Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq H \leq 10^9; 1\leq W \leq 10^9; 1\leq N \leq 10^5; 1\leq s_x,g_x\leq H; 1\leq s_y,g_y\leq W; 1\leq X_i \leq H; 1\leq Y_i \leq W; (s_x,s_y)
eq (g_x,g_y); (s_x,s_y)
eq (X_i,Y_i); (g_x,g_y)
eq (X_i,Y_i); If i
eq j, then (X_i,Y_i)
eq (X_j,Y_j).; All values in input are integers.
